text: Closed with exact detector identity and support accounting. DetectionResult now carries DetectorIdentity.Algorithm(full AlgorithmCard) or DetectorIdentity.Custom; raw Machine execution is runCustom and tidy refuses custom scientific export. Tidy consumes the bound card and rejects detection/AOI TemporalSupport disagreement. DetectionReport records support policy and policy-censored time, and durations/gap warnings use the selected SampleSupportLedger. Engbert-Kliegl emits named Kinematics failures for irregular sampling. The user-designated University of Potsdam toolbox is pinned at current HEAD a3eba6e9f1464c953c81fbd87944ba7678c2cf64; full-candidate behavior with toolbox radius now agrees, while boundary velocities, publication median-square thresholding, inclusive peak calculation, and invalid-observation behavior are explicit card assumptions/deviations. Even-length medians now use the mathematical midpoint. Discriminating mutants killed: irregular sampling silently dropped, custom detector forged as Algorithm, explicit support ignored, and upper-middle even median. Green evidence: detect JVM/JS 72 each, io JVM/JS 20 each, laws JVM 225 and JS 222; validation JSON and scientific summary digest are exact generator output. No staging, commit, or push.
